messages:
ben: FYI -- Support report: customer saw >1 provisional charge when router failed over to fallback model mid-stream and a toolcall was truncated. Logs attached (snippet below).

maria: ugh. is this the same 'provisional token' problem or a new variant?

ben: related but twist: the fallback happened after we emitted a partial stream chunk and the toolcall TTL expired. Router created new session on fallback and both sessions attributed provisional tokens. When stream ended, accounting reconciler only applied final confirmation to the fallback session, leaving the original provisional tokens uncleared.

sam: can you paste the log snippet?

ben: sure:
```
[2026-03-19T14:23:12Z] route=router-v2 session=abc123 model=redwood-xx status=stream_chunk emitted_tokens=128 provisional_token_id=pt-9
[2026-03-19T14:23:13Z] route=router-v2 session=abc123 toolcall=tts ttl_expired toolcall_state=truncated
[2026-03-19T14:23:14Z] route=router-v2 fallback=router-v2:fallback-us-east session=def456 model=redwood-yy provisional_token_id=pt-10
[2026-03-19T14:23:20Z] session=def456 confirmation=confirm_tokens token_confirmed=pt-10
```

anya: so pt-9 never got reconciled out?

ben: exactly. reconcilier looks for confirmations but doesn't find anything for pt-9 and we currently only expire provisional tokens after N days. Customer got charged for both.

raj: are we sure this is not a UI double-counting display bug? need to check ledger entries.

ben: ledger shows both provisional entries moved to billable state because the original session was later marked as 'orphaned' and our billing pipeline interprets orphaned provisional as billable for safety.

maria: that's bad. two problems: router losing provenance when doing fallback, and billing pipeline treating orphaned provisional too aggressively.

sam: quick mitigation: we can add a 'route_provenance' tag to the provisional token and prefer the earliest-confirmation wins policy. If a later fallback confirms, reconcile to the original route rather than double-bill.

anya: implementation note: need to surface route_provenance through router -> session_manager -> ledger. Right now token IDs are opaque. Maybe change header:
```
X-Route-Provenance: router-v2/path=orig,reason=fallback,to=router-v2/fallback-us-east
```

raj: also need a short-term console flag to show provisional tokens per-session so ops can spot double-provisioning. Add a tile: "provisional tokens (unconfirmed) by route"

maria: for billing pipeline change: make orphaned provisional default to credit-back after a 1h reconciliation window unless overridden by explicit engineer-ack for legal reasons. That should stop customer visible double billing while we fix root cause.

ben: +1 on 1h soft-credit. We should also add a nightly nearline reconciler job to stitch token provenance and emit corrective credits for any duplicates in last 7 days.

sam: risk: automated credits could be abused or cause downstream accounting noise. We need idempotency and an audit log event for every corrective credit.

anya: agree. let's require that reconciler emits a "correction_event" with fields: original_token, duplicate_token, credited_amount, reason. (we'll add to audit log).

maria: ops checklist: 1) router: add provenance header (owner: eng-runtime, ETA 3 days) 2) session_manager: propagate provenance to provisional token creation (owner: eng-platform, ETA 4 days) 3) billing pipeline: implement 1h soft-credit window + idempotent corrective credits (owner: finance-eng, ETA 5 days) 4) console: tile for provisional unconfirmed tokens + filter by route (owner: devex, ETA 7 days)

ben: can someone file the infra tickets? I'll make an incident postmortem-style doc after root cause is fixed.

raj: I'll open the billing ticket and include ledger samples.

sam: I'll own the router change. starting a branch now, will ping when there's a patch.

anya: devex will design the console tile and a small debug view showing token provenance.

billing-bot: Auto-note: Created billing ticket #BI-4821 and assigned to raj.

maria: thanks all. short-term: enable 1h soft-credit by config toggle for affected accounts (support can flip per-customer) until reconciler finishes.

ben: support heads-up: @support - please DM me any affected customer IDs; we'll prioritize toggles. :handshake: 

support (reacting): :thumbsup:

sam: patch uploaded to repo: PR #789. includes header change and tests for provenance propagation.

ben: merging when green. we'll run nearline reconciler on staging next week to validate no false credits.

maria: good plan. follow-up sync next Tues at 11am.
